items.context: The description 'A new test idea' is too vague to act on. We need to understand what domain this idea targets before any other decisions can be made. Is this about testing infrastructure, a product/scenario, or something else?

options.label: A new testing framework or tool for Vrooli scenarios
options.rationale: Builds on existing test-genie and scenario test infrastructure to provide better testing capabilities across the platform

options.label: A new scenario (product/service) that happens to be test-related
options.rationale: A standalone scenario that provides testing as a service — e.g., API testing, load testing, or regression testing as a monetizable product

options.label: An improvement to the existing test-genie scenario
options.rationale: Rather than building something new, enhance the existing AI-assisted test generation tool

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Provide your own description of what this idea actually is

items.context: Who will use or benefit from this? Understanding the audience shapes every downstream decision — architecture, UX, pricing, and scope.

options.label: Internal — Vrooli developers and agents
options.rationale: An internal tool that makes Vrooli's own development faster and more reliable

options.label: External — developers using Vrooli as a platform
options.rationale: A capability exposed to users who build on top of Vrooli

options.label: External — end users of a SaaS product
options.rationale: A standalone product targeting a market need

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Provide your own audience description

items.context: Every good idea starts with a clear problem. What pain point or gap does this address? Without a defined problem, we risk building something nobody needs.

options.label: Existing tests are too slow or unreliable
options.rationale: Focus on improving test execution speed, flakiness reduction, or parallelization

options.label: Test coverage is insufficient or hard to measure
options.rationale: Focus on coverage analysis, gap detection, and reporting

options.label: Writing tests is too manual or time-consuming
options.rationale: Focus on test generation, scaffolding, and AI-assisted authoring

options.label: No existing solution for a specific type of testing
options.rationale: Fill a gap — e.g., integration testing across scenarios, end-to-end testing, contract testing

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Describe the problem in freeform

items.context: How should this be delivered? This affects architecture, dependencies, and monetization strategy.

options.label: Vrooli scenario (API + optional UI)
options.rationale: Standard Vrooli scenario with Go API, optional React UI. Integrates with existing resource ecosystem.

options.label: CLI tool only
options.rationale: Lightweight command-line tool. Fast to build, easy to integrate into CI/CD pipelines.

options.label: Library / SDK
options.rationale: Reusable code package that other scenarios import. Maximum composability.

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Provide your own deployment model

items.context: This is currently priority 3 (medium). Should it stay there, or does the refined understanding of the idea change its urgency?

options.label: Keep at priority 3 — medium importance
options.rationale: It's a nice-to-have that can wait for higher-priority work to complete

options.label: Raise to priority 2 — high importance
options.rationale: This addresses an active pain point that's slowing down other work

options.label: Raise to priority 1 — critical
options.rationale: This is blocking other initiatives or causing significant harm

options.label: Lower to priority 4 — backlog for later
options.rationale: Good idea but not timely — revisit when bandwidth opens up

items.text: Vrooli already has test-genie (AI-assisted test generation at localhost:17480) and built-in scenario test infrastructure via `vrooli scenario test <name>`. Any new testing idea should be evaluated against these existing capabilities to avoid duplication.
